source: Existing local Netlisp binary, matching local design library, default Functional view; renderer returned inline SVG. Production endpoint required Ward authentication.
capture_notes: SVG keeps visual SVG CSS only, removes inline handlers and cursor styles; sets explicit 884x1144 size and dark background.
PNG rasterized from cleaned SVG with local Playwright Chromium; no Netlisp rebuild or Guardian invocation.
Geometry documents reference alias labels U1/R1 etc, not original fixture instance names.
Web renderer excludes NC pads 5, 28, 30, 32; the language tool may retain them explicitly.
Reference scene-graph CLI uses older layout; this capture uses actual default webpage SVG.
